Want to learn how to machine chest press with proper form to build a bigger, stronger chest? 💪 In this video, I'll show you exactly how to perform the machine chest press correctly, including proper seat height, hand positioning, range of motion, and common mistakes to avoid.

The seated chest press machine is one of the best chest exercises for building muscle, increasing upper body strength, and targeting your pectoral muscles. Whether you're a beginner learning how to use gym machines or an experienced lifter looking to maximize chest growth, mastering your chest press technique is essential.

🔥 In this video, you'll learn:
- How to set up the chest press machine correctly
- Proper chest press form and technique
- How to position your elbows and hands
- How to maximize chest activation and muscle growth
- Common machine chest press mistakes to avoid
- How to perform each rep safely and effectively

The machine chest press primarily targets your chest (pectoralis major) while also working your triceps and front deltoids. It's a great addition to any chest workout, push day, or upper body strength training routine.

Stop wasting reps with poor technique and start getting more out of your chest workouts!
